keyVerseDR: "...falling down they adored him: and opening their treasures, they offered him gifts..." (Mt 2:11)

level1.title: Wise Men Follow the Star
level1.story: A bright star led the wise men to Jesus. They found Him with His mother Mary. They gave Him gold, incense, and myrrh.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What gifts did the Wise Men bring?
What gift can you give Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I give You my heart. Amen.

activity.title: The star
activity.intro: Draw the other half of the star.

level2.title: The Magi Find the King
level2.story: Wise men came from the East, saying, "Where is He that is born king of the Jews? For we have seen His star." Herod gathered the priests, who said the Christ would be born in Bethlehem. The star went before the wise men until it stood over the place where the child was. They rejoiced with great joy, and entering the house, they found the child with Mary His mother. Falling down, they adored Him and offered Him gold, frankincense, and myrrh.
level2.keyLine: Falling down they adored him: and they offered him gifts.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does each gift say about Jesus?
How do you 'follow the star' today?
level2.prayer: Jesus, King of all, I offer You my life. Amen.

activity.title: The Magi's journey
scenes: The wise men see the star in the East
The star stops over the house in Bethlehem
They adore Jesus and give their gifts
